title: Corridors.
officialText:
Corridors shall comply with all of the requirements of subchapter six of this chapter, except as modified below:

(a)Capacity. The capacity of corridors shall be as listed in table 8-1.

(b)Changes in level. Changes in level requiring less than three risers in a corridor shall be by a ramp having a slope not greater than one in ten.
